entries.speaker: Black-Haired Student
entries.en: He didn't know that? Guess he really[n]can't study after all.

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: Cut it out! What if he hears you?[n]We don't know what he'd do to us!

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: Come on, turn around!

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Student
entries.en: Wow, he got it right... Is he really[n]a criminal?
entries.uk: Ого, він відповів правильно...[n]Він справді злочинець?

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Student
entries.en: I guess he's just a natural troublemaker[n]and can't study...

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: Why's someone like him in our school?

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Student
entries.en: Whoa, he actually knew that?

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: Maybe I should ask if I can borrow[n]his notes...

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Student
entries.en: That one was really obvious.

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: Why does he even come to class if[n]he doesn't care about studying?

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Student
entries.en: Wow, he was actually listening.

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: I'm kind of surprised. He seems like[n]the kind to just be spacing out.
entries.uk: Навіть дивно. З вигляду він із тих,[n]хто просто витає в хмарах.

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Student
entries.en: He didn't know that? The teacher even[n]said it...

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: Maybe he's sleeping with his eyes open.

entries.speaker: Mr. Inui
entries.en: Mishima-kun. Do you know the name[n]of the Roman emperor who participated[n]in the Olympics?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Huh!? U-Um...

entries.speaker: Mr. Inui
entries.en: It's Nero.

entries.speaker: Mr. Inui
entries.en: *sigh* It's good to throw yourself into[n]your club activities, but you shouldn't[n]sacrifice your studies.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Sorry...
